nodes.line: 繁荣的年月·第七次大迷宫潮
nodes.name: 交出披风
who: the copper-haired empress with the old sword
nodes.light: hot white afternoon sun of high summer from the upper left, yellow wheat glaring, a line of black dust rising from the torn ground far ahead
nodes.camera: from the top of the stone muster platform, over the commander's shoulder, looking down the steps and out across the wheat to the fissure, tilted
nodes.text: Scene: a summer afternoon on the east side of a great white wall, at a stone muster platform at the wall's foot. Beyond it lie fields of ripening wheat, and a mile out the fields have split: a black fissure three miles long has opened from north to south, the wheat rows sinking into it, and a dark tide is beginning to pour out of the ground. Beacon fires are being lit one after another along the wall top, and far off small carts flee south. In the near right foreground, large and partly cut off, the garrison commander, a grey-templed officer in a breastplate, stands in full profile facing left, holding a long white travelling cloak that has just been put into his two arms, his mouth half open. Going down the steps away from us, seen directly from behind, walks the copper-haired empress with the old sword: dark old-copper hair tied low at the nape, a plain soldier's coat, an old sword with a rope-wrapped grip at her left hip, her left hand resting on its pommel, her right hand hanging loose. She is alone on the steps and she is walking straight toward the fissure. Chaff and heat shimmer drift large and blurred across the near corners.
nodes.note: 一幕第二拍（源稿第157行）：理查德说三段墙一段兵，她说那就去要人，把披风交给他，一个人下了台阶往裂口走，腰上挂着挽昼。麦地裂口照第156行。

nodes.line: 繁荣的年月·第七次大迷宫潮
nodes.name: 摸黑刻名
nodes.light: almost no light: a few torches being handed down over a stone rail high on the right, their orange catching the chisel and the fresh-cut grooves; blue-black night everywhere else
nodes.camera: close along the face of the terrace wall, level with the chisel, the grey giant far behind over their shoulders, tilted
nodes.text: Scene: the dead of night on the stepped east face of the great white wall, seven terraces rising from the ground to the battlements; every torch on the slope has gone out. Beyond the wall, taller than it, a vast shape wrapped in grey cloth has turned toward the slope, and under the cloth pale faces rise to the surface and sink again. In the foreground, at the back wall of the third terrace, the snow-haired stone-carver works in full profile facing right: cold-white skin, snow-white hair cut level at the ears; her left hand holds a chisel to the stone, her right hand swings a mallet, and under her hands a column of freshly cut lines runs down the wall, one short line under another, dozens already cut. Close behind her, facing us, the sandy-haired wall soldier, a young man with a tuft of hair standing up at the front and a bulging cloth bag at his hip, bends to the newest line with his right forefinger on it and his left hand cupped at his mouth, shouting it out. Around them on the terrace, volunteers with blank wooden tags round their necks stand frozen; one has begun to walk away toward the dark edge and another catches his sleeve. High on the right, over a stone rail at the wall top, arms reach down from the far side passing lit torches from hand to hand. Stone chips and sparks fly large and blurred through the near corners.
nodes.note: 二幕第七拍（源稿第173行）：木牌上的字口一个一个平了，奥达在第三层的台壁上摸黑一口气一行往下刻，蒂洛跟在后头一行一行叫。西坡从墙头石栏递火把照第172行。噬名者的样子照第168行（裹着灰布，布底下一张一张脸浮上来又沉下去）。刻的字只画成一行一行刻痕。

nodes.line: 繁荣的年月·第七次大迷宫潮
nodes.name: 半夜天亮
who: the copper-haired empress with the old sword
nodes.light: a blade of white-gold daylight tearing the black night open from the ground to the horizon, everything on its near side lit like full morning with shadows thrown miles long toward us, night still black at the two edges of the sky
nodes.camera: low on the ground behind her, looking up along her raised sword at the three giants and the opened sky, strongly tilted
nodes.text: Scene: midnight on a plain of trampled wheat in front of a long black fissure in the earth. Beyond the fissure stand three shapes taller than a city wall. The first is bent-backed, hung with loose chains, each of its hands a set of five iron tongs, its face one blank plate of polished copper. The second is wrapped head to foot in grey cloth with dim faces drifting under it. The third is a bare skeleton whose empty belly is a pit and whose mouth opens downward. Three tall banners of grey and red stand before them. In the middle foreground, alone, the copper-haired empress with the old sword is seen directly from behind, small against them: dark old-copper hair tied low at the nape, a plain soldier's coat, both hands on the rope-wrapped hilt of an old straight sword at the end of one rising cut, the blade pointing at the sky. Along the line of that cut the whole night has come open like a curtain from the fissure to the horizon: a broad band of clear morning sky stands in the black, the three banners are snapping in half, the cloth giant and the skeleton giant are thinned to half transparency where the light crosses them, and the great chain that ties the bent one back into the fissure has broken in two. Her shadow and the shadows of the wheat stubble run back toward us for miles. Far behind on the left, small, the white wall with every figure on it turned to look. Chaff and motes of light fly large and blurred through the near corners.
nodes.note: 三幕第一拍（源稿第179行）：半夜，她拔了挽昼，一剑下去，从裂口到天边的夜整个掀开，半夜里天亮了一回；三面旗齐齐断了，噬名者和饥渊者叫那一道光钉薄了一半，铸枷者背后拴进裂口的主链断成两截。三尊的样子照第168行原文，是场面写明的脸。不画日头。

nodes.line: 繁荣的年月·第七次大迷宫潮
nodes.name: 还火
nodes.light: one torch flame warm between the two men, a deep blue summer night, starlight on scorched stone
nodes.camera: level with the top of the stone rail, the torch in the centre, one man on each side of the rail, slightly tilted
nodes.text: Scene: a quiet summer night on top of the great white wall. A waist-high stone rail runs along the middle of the wall top, the line between its two sides; the rail here is marked with a row of black scorch marks, one beside another. On the near side of the rail, in full profile facing right, stands the sandy-haired wall soldier, a young man with a tuft of hair standing up at the front, his left arm in a sling; with his right hand he holds out one burning torch across the rail. On the far side, in full profile facing left, the old fire-horn officer receives it: a broad old demon-kin soldier with copper wire wound round both horns, his right hand closing on the shaft of the torch just below the soldier's hand, his left hand resting on the rail. Neither is smiling; both look at the flame. Behind the young soldier a handful of east-side soldiers stand watching, one holding a loaf of bread; behind the officer a handful of horned west-side soldiers stand the same way. Below the wall on the near side, dim in starlight, a long pale furrow is ploughed down the stone terraces, and out on the plain one small round pit marks where the fissure closed. Sparks from the torch drift large and soft across the near corners.
nodes.note: 收束末一拍（源稿第194行）：对出数的那一夜，东坡第二段的兵点着一根火把，从那一截石栏上递回了西坡，营官接了，说火不算兵。石栏上的焦痕照第186行，白沟和哑井照第183、189行。递火的兵写成蒂洛。

nodes.line: 繁荣的年月·雷暴荒地的头一座塔
nodes.name: 起钉
who: the four-armed woman with teal braids
nodes.light: low warm afternoon sun through an open doorway onto the threshold, cool shade inside the hall
nodes.camera: low on the doorstep beside his boot, close on the nails in his palm, the table and the basket behind, slightly tilted
nodes.text: Scene: a spring afternoon at the door of a guild hall in a city of black stone. On the threshold sits the rust-haired troll, a very big, heavy-shouldered demon-kin with coarse rust-red hair cropped to a brush, facing us: one huge boot is off and held sole-up on his knee in his left hand, and with a small pair of pincers in his right hand he is drawing an iron hobnail out of the sole. Beside him on the step stands a neat row of nails already pulled, dozens of them, and a small cloth pouch. His face is careful and a little sad. Behind him inside the hall, at a table by a board of pinned notices, sits the four-armed woman with teal braids, in full profile facing left: long sea-teal hair in four braids, fine teal scales on her forearms; her upper right hand holds a thin rod of black glass, her upper left hand turns a page of a ledger, and her two lower hands push a wicker basket forward across the table. In the basket lie knives, belt buckles, coins and buttons. A short halfling woman is tipping her pockets out into it while others in the queue laugh. Dust motes hang large and soft in the sunlit near corners.
nodes.note: 一幕第三拍（源稿第434行）：丰克坐在分会门口一颗一颗起靴底的钉子，起了大半个下午，四十八颗。佐拉的篮子和黑曜石细杆照第432行，蔻琪掏得最快照第433行。

nodes.line: 繁荣的年月·雷暴荒地的头一座塔
nodes.name: 第十一步
who: the towering thunder lord with the chain
the four-armed woman with teal braids
nodes.light: violet-white lightning flashes behind him across a purple-black sky, a steady small lamp at the foot of the tower on the right, the white chalk line pale on scorched ground
nodes.camera: low on the scorched ground at the chalk line, looking along it, the giant on the left of the line and the tower on the right, tilted
nodes.text: Scene: dusk on a scorched plateau at the edge of a wasteland where the sky is purple-black and lightning falls without rain; hollow glass tubes stand in the sand where bolts have struck. On the right rises the foot of a tall tower built of black glass blocks, wound with a spiral of bronze-gold wire, and a circle of white chalk is drawn on the ground ten steps out from it. Outside the circle stands one post of black glass hung with small brass seals, buckles and a pouch of nails. At the chalk line, just outside it, the towering thunder lord with the chain has stopped, in full profile facing right: a giant grey-skinned demon-kin lord far taller than a man, heavy and calm; his right hand holds the end of a long bronze-gold chain, his left hand hangs open, and he is looking down at the white line at his feet. Behind him the chain runs back into the wasteland with twenty-three ragged, unhurt people locked along it. A bolt of lightning is coming down right behind him, and it bends aside from his body and runs into the chain at his wrist. Inside the circle, facing him in full profile facing left, the four-armed woman with teal braids holds up her upper right hand, palm out, to stop him, a rod of black glass in her upper left hand, her lower hands clutching a ledger. Glass dust and violet sparks drift large and blurred across the near corners.
nodes.note: 二幕第六拍（源稿第447行）：格罗姆牵着一条山铜链子从荒地正中走回来，链上锁着二十三个人，佐拉喊住他说塔底十步，他低头看了看白线，那就十一步；雷一回也没落在他身上，爬上链子的光钻进他的手腕。格罗姆用 1001 那一套的立绘。

nodes.line: 繁荣的年月·雷暴荒地的头一座塔
nodes.name: 雷骨之裂
nodes.light: blinding violet-white lightning held inside a tree of glass, turning night to day, the black tower a dark bar on the right, the hammer blow a white star at the centre
nodes.camera: low at the foot of the stone walls, looking up the trunk of the glass tree as the hammer lands, strongly tilted
nodes.text: Scene: night on a scorched plateau under a purple-black sky. A tree of glass taller than a tower has torn itself out of a pit: hundreds of hollow glass lightning-tubes twisted together into a trunk, its branches full of trapped violet light, and every bolt of lightning for miles around is bending in the sky to strike it. On its trunk one last great knot burns too bright to look at, with a crack running under it. High in its crown, small, stands an old scorched troll with both arms raised to the sky. Low walls of raw stone have been heaved up round the tree's roots. At this instant the blue-scaled dragonborn woman is in mid-leap off the top of the nearest stone wall, in full profile facing right: snow-white short hair, azure scales on her neck and forearms all standing on end with white fire jumping between them, one scale on the side of her neck burnt white; both hands bring a hammer of black glass down on the crack, and from the blow the whole trunk is bursting into flying shards. Between the tree and a black tower wound with bronze-gold wire on the right, the rust-haired troll stands braced, facing us: both bare hands raised, catching a forked bolt in his palms, the scorched ground under his feet melted into a ring of glass, his palms red and blistered. Behind a wall, small, a halfling woman whirls a sling. Glass splinters and sparks fly large and blurred across the near corners.
nodes.note: 三幕第六拍（源稿第459行）：斯薇娅迈上十步线，鳞一片一片立起来，颈侧一片鳞烧白了，然后跳上石墙，一锤砸在那道裂上。雷骨树、亚罗什站在树冠上照第456行，丰克站在树和塔中间接雷、脚下熔成一圈玻璃照第458行。raw 只管丰克烫红的手心和她烧白的鳞。

nodes.line: 繁荣的年月·雷暴荒地的头一座塔
nodes.name: 头一盏灯
who: the four-armed woman with teal braids
nodes.light: one steady, unflickering white light at the centre, between two rods, throwing every shadow straight outward from it; soft blue night beyond
nodes.camera: at ground level a few steps from the lamp, the lamp dead centre, long shadows fanning toward us, almost level
nodes.text: Scene: a still night at the foot of the black glass tower on the scorched plateau; the storm season is over and the sky is clear and dark. On a low bench stands a squat black jar with its lid on, and two bronze-gold wires run from it to a small frame holding two rods of carbon, tip to tip. Between the two tips burns one small arc of pure white light that does not flicker, and every shadow round it stretches straight outward across the ground. Beside the lamp, sitting on the ground and facing us with her knees drawn up, is the blue-scaled dragonborn woman: snow-white short hair, azure scales on her neck and forearms lying flat, one scale on her neck burnt white; her arms rest on her knees, her hands empty, her eyes on the light, her face quiet and amazed. On the right, standing in full profile facing left, the four-armed woman with teal braids writes in a ledger held in her two lower hands, a pen in her upper right hand, her upper left hand shading her eyes. Further back, small, an old scorched troll sits tied to a post of black glass with a plain rope, his head lifted toward the light, and a big rust-haired troll sits beside him. Around the tower's foot lies a great heap of broken glass. Tiny moths circle large and soft in the near corners.
nodes.note: 三幕幕终（源稿第461行）到收束第一拍（第464行）：两根炭棒中间亮起一道不跳不灭的白光，照得塔底下的影子一齐往外拉长，斯薇娅在灯边坐了一夜；亚罗什在桩上看了一夜灯。放在收束那一格。

nodes.line: 繁荣的年月·屠林令
nodes.name: 侧身
nodes.light: one small honey-coloured lamp carried in her hand, warm on the two faces, blue-black dark falling away below with a few cold drips of light on wet rock
nodes.camera: from just below them on the stair, looking up at the gap in the steps and the two figures, the door far above, tilted
nodes.text: Scene: night under a great forest, at the top of a stair cut round the wall of an immense cavern; enormous tree roots hang down through the rock into the dark. High above, small, a door of white oak stands ajar with warm light behind it. One stone step is missing from the stair. On the step below the gap stands the lilac-haired dark-elf soldier, in full profile facing left: grey-white skin beaded with moisture, messy pale lilac hair, a young face; on his back a clay jar of oil, an unlit torch thrust in his belt. His left hand grips a thick root beside him, and where he grips it the bark has swelled out into a knob the size of a foothold across the gap; he has turned his body flat against the rock to leave the stair free, his right hand held open at his side, his eyes lowered. Stepping down across the gap onto that knob, facing us, comes the wood-elf door-keeper: pale flaxen hair in one thick braid coiled round her head with a small acorn pinned in it, a plain green-grey dress to the ankles; her right hand holds a small lit beeswax lamp, her left hand steadies her against the rock. Below them the stair is lined, as far down as the lamp reaches, with silent soldiers carrying oil jars and unlit torches. Drops of water fall large and blurred through the near corners.
nodes.note: 一幕第三拍（源稿第765行）：艾茵开门下阶，门底下缺了一级石阶，排在最前头的兵是奇安，他抓紧旁边的根，根皮鼓出一处落脚的地方，侧身让她过去，一句话没说。背着油罐、拿着没点的火把的兵照开局。

nodes.line: 繁荣的年月·屠林令
nodes.name: 攥住刀影
nodes.light: the white flash of a raised blade lighting the stair, dull orange of a dying fire on the half-burnt door above, clouds of steam, everything else black
nodes.camera: low on the stair behind the captain's heels, his long shadow on the steps in the foreground, looking up at the door, strongly tilted
nodes.text: Scene: night at the top of the cavern stair under the forest. Above, a door of white oak is charred black across half its width and still smouldering; steam drifts where water runs down the rock onto the last flames. The thick roots that framed the stair have drawn together below the door like the fingers of a closing fist, and one of them has just been cut through. In the middle, on the stair, a tall dark-elf captain in black mail, grey-white skin, hair tied back, stands with his back to us and a long curved blade raised in both hands above his head, shining white. The blade has stopped in the air. On the steps behind him lies his own shadow, long and sharp, and out of that shadow a slim arm has risen to the elbow, its hand closed tight on the shadow of the blade. Beside the arm the dark-elf shadow dancer is rising out of the same shadow, facing us, seen from the waist up: black hair with a violet sheen falling loose over her right eye, a close dark dancer's dress with long sleeves, her other hand flat on the step, her face calm. At the door above, facing us, the wood-elf door-keeper with a flaxen braid coiled round her head presses both palms flat against the scorched wood from the inside, her eyes shut. Behind the captain a file of soldiers with torches has begun to back down the stair. Ash and steam drift large and blurred across the near corners.
nodes.note: 二幕第四、五拍（源稿第776、777行）：艾茵两手按在门上，白栎自己往下收根，根道像一只攥起来的拳头；门将一刀劈开合拢的根，他脚下的影子里伸出一只手，攥住了他的刀影，刀停在半空落不下来，夜魇从影子里的近路赶到了。门将贝洛克没有立绘，画成背影。

nodes.line: 繁荣的年月·屠林令
nodes.name: 摘灯
nodes.light: one unshaded lamp blazing white-gold at the centre like a sun underground, every shadow in the hall streaming toward it, the cavern above lit for the first time up to its roof
nodes.camera: low on the floor of the hall beside the writing desk, looking up past the dancer at the lamp and the king, the cavern soaring behind, strongly tilted
nodes.text: Scene: the bottom of an immense cavern city whose stairs wind up its walls for days; a bare stone court with one heavy writing desk and one tall iron lamp-stand. The lamp's cover has been thrown off, and it burns like a small white sun; far up the cavern walls, thousands of tiny house-lights and stairs stand revealed. All the shadows of the city pour across the floor toward the court in long black streams and gather into the hand of the old dark-elf king, who stands on the right in full profile facing left: grey-white skin, long white hair combed straight back, a dark robe of state; his left hand holds a blade made of solid shadow, as long as a street, lowered after its stroke, and his right hand, holding a pen, hangs over a sheet on the desk with its little finger raised. Far behind him half a mile of the cavern wall has been sheared off and is sliding. On the desk a human-shaped shadow lies pinned by a point of the black blade. Upon that pinned shadow dances the dark-elf shadow dancer, in the middle of the picture, facing us: black hair with a violet sheen loose over her right eye, a close dark dress with long sleeves, balanced on the ball of her left foot in mid-turn, her right arm stretched up, her fingers an inch from the ring of the blazing lamp, her left arm out for balance. From the darkness above, a root as thick as a tower is descending into the court, and riding it down, small, the wood-elf door-keeper with a coiled flaxen braid hugs the root with her left arm, an unlit beeswax lamp in her right hand. Shreds of shadow and motes of light whirl large and blurred through the near corners.
nodes.note: 三幕第四到六拍（源稿第787到789行）：王左手掀了王灯的罩，像地底下升起一轮太阳，全城的影子叫他攥成一把刀，一刀削下对面洞壁半里长的一片，夜魇的影子叫他钉在书桌上；她踩着钉住的影子起舞，踏进去摘王灯；灯离钩的那一刻松开的大根垂进了王庭，艾茵跟着落下来。并成摘灯以前的一瞬。王右手那一笔还没落（小指翘着）照第786行。

nodes.line: 繁荣的年月·屠林令
nodes.name: 多舀一勺
nodes.light: green-gold forest daylight slanting through leaves from the upper left, warm on the honey, cool blue shade in the stair mouth below the door
nodes.camera: close at the threshold, level with the honey jar and the ladle, the charred half of the door filling the left edge, slightly tilted
nodes.text: Scene: a late autumn morning in a deep forest, at a door of white oak set between the roots of a giant tree. Half of the door is charred black; the other half is pale sound wood, and a beeswax lamp hangs beside it. The door stands open, and under it a stair goes down into blue shade. On the threshold, seated on a low stool in full profile facing right, the wood-elf door-keeper, pale flaxen hair in one thick braid coiled round her head with a small acorn pinned in it, is ladling honey: her right hand tips a wooden ladle, a thick gold thread of honey running from it into a clay pot, her left hand steadies a big honey jar on her knee; her lips are pressed shut, her eyes smiling. In front of her, standing on the top step in full profile facing left, the lilac-haired dark elf holds the clay pot up in both hands to catch the honey: grey-white skin beaded with moisture, messy pale lilac hair, a wicker basket on his back, plain clothes and no armour; his head is tilted, puzzled, his mouth open in a question. On the ground beside her stool sits a small pot of green mint. Leaves and motes of pollen drift large and soft in the near corners.
nodes.note: 收束第四拍（源稿第798行）：中旬一日白栎门照旧开门换蜜，奇安背着篮子上来，问她今天怎么一句话不说，她给他多舀了一勺。焦了半扇的门照第797行，薄荷照第799行。

nodes.line: 繁荣的年月·头一回实习
nodes.name: 掌心晶尘
nodes.light: clear early-spring sunrise from the right, gold on faces and jackets, long cool shadows of the queue on the paving
nodes.camera: at the height of the boy's open palm, close, the guild master on the bench beside it and the long queue behind, slightly tilted
nodes.text: Scene: sunrise on the first day of spring at the door of a great stone hall by the mouth of the well. A queue of sixteen-year-olds in identical short grey-green jackets stretches from the door away into the distance, hundreds of them. On a plain bench beside the door sits the red-haired tiefling guild master, in full profile facing right: dark red hair in one tail, two swept-back horns with a copper ring on the left one, a grey cloak; his elbows rest on his knees, his hands are loosely clasped, and he looks up at the boy in front of him with a half-smile. Facing him, in full profile facing left, stands the apricot-haired boy, sixteen, messy apricot-yellow hair sticking up, a new small brass seal on a cord in his left fist; his right hand is held out open, palm up, and from the palm a few grains of pale blue crystal dust are spilling, glittering, and falling to the foot of the doorpost, where they go on glowing. He is grinning. Next in the queue behind him, facing us with her arms folded, stands the frost-blue wolf-eared girl, sixteen, ragged frost-blue hair, wolf ears with white tips pricked forward, a bushy tail, frowning at the dust. At the far end of the queue, small, a stern woman counts heads with a hand that has three fingers. Motes of blue dust drift large and soft in the near corners.
nodes.note: 一幕第一拍（源稿第1093行）：吉迪恩出来一个问一个，下去以后想拿什么回来；琼尼说光，他掌心漏下几粒淡蓝的晶尘，落在门柱脚下还亮着；露珀说第七层的水。孔切塔左手只剩三根指头照第1094行。孩子十六岁，不受伤。

nodes.line: 繁荣的年月·头一回实习
nodes.name: 没有铃
who: the copper-haired guide with the bells
the coral-braided tiefling with the censer
nodes.light: warm camp lantern light from behind us at the top of the stair, a soft green-white mist glowing up from below, the bottom of the stair lost in it
nodes.camera: from the top of the stair looking steeply down past the three of them into the mist, strongly tilted
nodes.text: Scene: deep underground at the head of a stone stair that goes down into warm, glowing mist; moss and hanging vines cover the walls. Three steps down stands the frost-blue wolf-eared girl, sixteen, in a short grey-green jacket with a small bell on her pack strap, facing down the stair with her back to us, her wolf ears flat, her tail low; she is unhurt and standing free. Just above her, in full profile facing right, the copper-haired guide with the bells, a man of forty-one with short copper-red hair and a row of small bells on his own strap, has caught the back of her collar in his right fist and is hauling her up, his left hand gripping the wall, his face white. Beside him, crouched on the step in full profile facing left, the coral-braided tiefling with the censer, coral-red hair in one thick braid, two short sooty horns, has just cut through a vine with a short knife in her right hand; the two cut ends lie on the step dripping thick sweet sap, and in her left hand a small smoking censer trails a white line of smoke that sinks down the stair. Far below in the mist, at the foot of the stair, stands a blurred figure with the same outline as the guide, one arm raised to beckon, with no face and no bells on it at all. At the top of the stair behind us, small, a tiny boy points down at it. Glowing spores drift large and blurred across the near corners.
nodes.note: 二幕应声灯第二手（源稿第1108行）：阶下有朗贝尔的声音喊她，露珀下了三级，真的朗贝尔从后头拽住她的后领，柯蕾特一刀断了藤，断口滴着甜汁，裘德小声说底下那个向导背上没有铃。藤缠脚踝那一下不画（未满十八岁的人不画被缠住），画藤已经断了的一瞬。底下那个不画脸。

nodes.line: 繁荣的年月·头一回实习
nodes.name: 真光
who: the coral-braided tiefling with the censer
the copper-haired guide with the bells
nodes.light: a spray of true pale-blue crystal light flung from the boy's hand at the centre, dozens of false pale-blue lamps dimming above, white censer smoke lit from within, deep green-black below
nodes.camera: from the floor of the cavity looking up at the hanging mushroom and its lamps, the boy's flung dust arcing toward the lens, strongly tilted
nodes.text: Scene: a great hollow under the floor of the well, shaped like an upturned bowl. From its roof a giant mushroom hangs upside down, cap downward, and from under the cap dangle dozens of pale-blue lamps, each on a long pale vine; they are going dim, all but one that has never flickered, high on the stalk. White smoke fills the hollow in slow coils, and in it every vine shows clearly. In the middle the apricot-haired boy, sixteen, in a short grey-green jacket, stands free and unhurt, in full profile facing right: his right arm has just swept up and flung a whole handful of glittering pale-blue crystal dust into the air, his left hand pushes his pack away from him, and the vines are wrapped only round the pack, which is tearing loose from his shoulders. Beside him a wolf-eared girl with frost-blue hair, unhurt, slices the pack strap with a small knife. On the left, facing us, the coral-braided tiefling with the censer stands with her feet apart: coral-red hair in one thick braid, two short sooty horns; her right hand swings an open smoking censer on its chain, her left hand hauls on a thick white rope of smoke that runs up and is knotted round the stalk of the mushroom. On the right, in full profile facing left, the copper-haired guide with the bells stands with his head thrown back, singing at the top of his voice, his right hand shaking a strap of small bells, his left hand held out toward the children; spores are shaking loose from the roof like snow. Behind them three more children in grey-green jackets, one bracing a shield overhead, one cutting vines, one very small boy pointing at the unflickering lamp. Spores and blue sparks whirl large and blurred through the near corners.
nodes.note: 三幕第五、六拍（源稿第1117、1118行）：柯蕾特掀了提炉的盖，烟灌满了大腔，假灯底下的藤一条一条显了形；朗贝尔开了嗓，腔顶的孢子震成一场雪；琼尼把掌心的晶屑全弹了出去，藤死死缠着他那一包采来的亮，露珀摸出小刀割包。孩子不画被藤裹住的那一下，画成藤只缠着包、人是脱开的。巨菌没有脸。

nodes.line: 繁荣的年月·头一回实习
nodes.name: 灰印
who: the stern instructor with three fingers on her left hand
nodes.light: soft spring daylight in an open stone court, a field of tiny warm lights glowing inside the wall, two of them ringed in pale grey
nodes.camera: close along the face of the wall at the height of the children's hands, the two grey rings near the centre, slightly tilted
nodes.text: Scene: a spring day in the gate court of a school built on a great rock shelf. One whole wall of the court is smooth dark stone, and inside the stone glow hundreds of tiny points of warm light, each the size of a fingernail, each with a small chalk mark under it. Near the middle, two points sit side by side, and round each of the two is a ring of pale grey. In front of them stand two sixteen-year-olds in short grey-green jackets, seen directly from behind, each pressing a small brass seal against the wall with the right hand: on the left a boy with messy apricot-yellow hair, on the right the frost-blue wolf-eared girl, her white-tipped ears upright, her bushy tail swinging once. Both are thin and pale from long sleep, unhurt, standing straight. On the right, in full profile facing left, the stern instructor with three fingers on her left hand, a weathered woman in a plain coat, holds out a small flat stone on her open right palm, her left hand raised a little in front of her coat and plainly visible: it has only three digits, the thumb and two fingers, the last two fingers missing at the knuckle with old healed stumps; it is not a whole hand. In front of her, in full profile facing right, the copper-haired guide, short copper-red hair with white at the temples, a pad of bandage over his right ear, reaches for the stone with his right hand, his left hand holding a strap of small bells; his eyes are on the two children, and he is close to laughing. Up on the broken edge of the rock above the court, small, three younger children lie on their stomachs watching. Chalk dust drifts large and soft in the near corners.
nodes.note: 收束第四、五拍（源稿第1126、1127行）：两个人在印壁上按了印，那两点合上了，灭过一回的地方留下两圈淡灰，挨着；孔切塔这才把那块小石头放进了朗贝尔手里。朗贝尔右耳那一蓬孢子写成耳朵上垫着布。岩台断口上三个三年级的孩子照第1128行。｜11-25 第三手：第一稿康切塔垂着的左手画成了完整的手，三指的记号没出来，写明重画。

nodes.line: 繁荣的年月·一座城自己的井
nodes.name: 哑钟
who: the ice-blue-haired clerk in white gloves
nodes.light: cold blue dusk between two snow ridges, hard white glare from crystal lamps along the wall top falling across the well-head, long blue shadows on trodden snow
nodes.camera: low at the rim of the well-head, looking up under the bell at the two men's hands, the lamp-lit wall behind, slightly tilted
nodes.text: Scene: dusk in a small walled city pressed between two snow ridges on a mountain pass; white crystal lamps already burn along the wall top though the sky is still pale. In the middle of the well square stands a low round stone well-head, and over it a timber frame with one big bronze bell. The bell cannot ring: its clapper is lashed flat against the inside of the bell with a man's leather belt, and from the clapper a long rope hangs straight down into the dark of the well. On the right, on the east side of the well-head, the council speaker stands in full profile facing left: a tall thin man of fifty-four with very short pale gold hair gone frost-white at the temples, in a long dark coat of office. His right hand hauls the tongue of the belt through its buckle one notch tighter, his left hand holds the buckle flat against the bronze; his face is grave and shut. On the left, sitting on the west rim of the well-head in full profile facing right, the old white-bearded well-keeper, white hair, his beard braided in one strand and tied with a bit of well rope, rests both rope-scarred hands on his knees and looks up at the bell, not at the man. Between them and a little further back, facing us, stands the ice-blue-haired clerk in white gloves, twenty-two, her long ice-blue hair tied at the nape, her two gloved hands gripped together in front of her, her eyes on the buckle. Behind her, small, four travellers still dusty from the road wait in a loose row: a very tall dragonborn woman with red-gold scales and short cherry-red hair, a thin tiefling with messy black hair and two short horns, a broad dwarf with a flax-coloured beard in three braids, and a tiny halfling woman with a medicine basket on her back. Two city guards with spears are stepping up to either side of the bell frame. Through the open city gate, far off, the cook fires of buyers' wagons glow behind a timber fence. Snow dust and lamp glare drift large and soft in the near corners.
nodes.note: 一幕对头头一手（源稿第1430行）：井台上吊着一口铜钟，钟舌叫一根皮带勒在钟壁上，舌底的长绳垂进老井筒；尼亚尔坐在井台西边，议长站在东头，当着四个客人把皮带又收紧一扣，叫两个城卫守住钟架。栅外的买主照第1429行。四个外乡人是远处的小人，没进 who。

nodes.line: 繁荣的年月·一座城自己的井
nodes.name: 红晶门牌
who: the ice-blue-haired clerk in white gloves
nodes.light: a deep red glow from inside walls of dark crystal on every side, one harsh white crystal lamp in the girl's hand cutting a hard white edge on the three of them
nodes.camera: at the height of the door latch, close behind the girl's outstretched hand, the red street running away downhill beyond, strongly tilted
nodes.text: Scene: far underground, below the ninth floor of a city's well, in a passage where dark red crystal has grown itself into a street. House fronts, shuttered windows, door plates and worn stone steps are all one piece of the same dark red crystal, glowing faintly from inside: a perfect copy of a lane in the city above, but mirrored left to right. Nobody lives in it; every window is blank. In the middle of the picture is one house door of red crystal with a small plate beside it scored with fine unreadable marks. In front of that door, seen directly from behind, stands the ice-blue-haired clerk in white gloves, twenty-two, her long ice-blue hair tied at the nape, in a padded travelling coat: her right hand is stretched out toward the door and has stopped a clear hand's width short of it, a visible gap of empty air between her gloved fingertips and the crystal; she does not touch the door, and her left hand holds up a white crystal lamp that is burning far too bright. On the right, in full profile facing left, the thin tiefling lockbreaker, messy black hair with a blue sheen and two short horns curling forward, has stepped in beside her: his left hand is slipped flat, palm toward her, into the gap between her fingertips and the door, touching neither her nor the door, and his right hand is clamped over a thick ring of old keys at his belt so that they cannot ring; his mouth is set. On the left, low down, the flax-bearded dwarf well-measurer, a broad dwarf whose great flax-coloured beard hangs in three braids strung with small bronze rings, crouches in full profile facing right at a second doorway whose red crystal frame has grown only halfway up: his right hand holds a brass plumb-bob on a copper wire against the unfinished post, his left hand holds a folding rule open, and one eye is squinted shut. Further up the street behind them, small, a very tall dragonborn woman with red-gold scales stands guard with a long spear, and a tiny halfling woman with a basket on her back lifts her nose to the air. The street runs away downhill into a deeper red. Red crystal dust drifts large and blurred across the near corners.
nodes.note: 二幕第七拍（源稿第1441行）：口子往下走半天，暗红的晶长成了墙、窗、门牌，是进城那天走过的井绳巷，朝向是反的；街当中是暖井家的门，苏妮瓦伸出去的手停在半路，瑞克斯腰上有一把钥匙捅得开它，他说不敲，也不开；韦蒙德盯着一副只长了一半的门框。晶灯亮得刺眼照第1431行尼亚尔的话。门牌写成认不出的细痕。｜11-25 第三手：第一稿苏妮娃的手和雷克斯的手都按在了门上（要紧的就是“差一掌没碰着”），写明空着一掌重画。

nodes.line: 繁荣的年月·一座城自己的井
nodes.name: 断钟带
nodes.light: a pillar of red-gold light rising out of the well behind them and flooding the square from below, snow ridges lit red on both sides, a deep blue night sky above
nodes.camera: low under the bell frame, close on the bell's clapper and the knife, the pillar of light rising behind, strongly tilted
nodes.text: Scene: night in a small mountain city built round a single well, on a pass between two snow ridges; the roofs carry lamps of white crystal. In the middle of the well square a pillar of red-gold light is rising straight out of the well, the stone rail round it steaming, the frost on the well-head melting into running water; the two ridges glow red. In the foreground stands a timber bell frame with one big bronze bell, a rope hanging from it into the well, and the bell's clapper has been lashed dumb with a man's leather belt wound tight round it. At this instant the belt is parting. The old white-bearded well-keeper, white hair, his beard braided in one strand and tied with a bit of well rope, stands in full profile facing right with his arm at full stretch: his right hand has just drawn a short broad well-keeper's knife up through the belt, the blade passing a finger's width from another man's knuckles; his left hand pushes a guard's spear point aside. Facing him in full profile facing left stands the council speaker, a tall man with very short pale gold hair gone frost-white at the temples, in a long dark coat of office: his right hand, which was gripping the belt, has just opened, and his left hand hangs at his side; his face is stricken, his lips parted. Two city guards with spears stand frozen behind him. All round the square, small, people in nightclothes have come out of their doors and are staring at the light. Flakes of melting frost and red sparks fly large and blurred across the near corners.
nodes.note: 三幕对头第三手（源稿第1410行那一条的三幕第六拍）：井口的光一起，议长自己伸手攥住了皮带，尼亚尔说她数到一百了，议长的手松了一口气的工夫，刀贴着他的指节过去，皮带断了。井口冲起一柱赤金的光、井台上的晶霜化成水照第五拍。

nodes.line: 繁荣的年月·一座城自己的井
nodes.name: 墙上木牌
nodes.light: the last cold blue of an early-spring dusk on snow, and from deep inside the pit rings of white crystal light coming on one above another, lighting the wall top from below
nodes.camera: close along the outside face of the wall among the hanging tags, the woman's raised hands near the centre, the lit pit seen past the wall's broken edge, slightly tilted
nodes.text: Scene: early-spring dusk in a snowy mountain pass between two ridges. Where a small walled city stood there is now only its ring of wall, and inside the ring one vast round pit: the whole city has sunk into its own well. Far down in the pit roofs, lanes and a bell frame can still be made out, overgrown with white crystal, and as the daylight fails the crystal is lighting up from the bottom, ring above ring, like lamps being lit in rising circles. Across the foreground runs the outside face of the east wall, and it is hung thick with small wooden tags on cords, hundreds of them, each scratched with a few fine unreadable marks, stirring in the wind. In the middle a woman in a patched travelling coat, a grey wool scarf over her hair, stands seen directly from behind and reaches up with both arms to an iron ring in the wall: her left hand holds one more wooden tag against the ring, her right hand pulls its cord tight. Beside her on the right, in full profile facing left, an old man in a sheepskin coat holds a bundle of blank tags against his chest with his left arm and shades his eyes with his right hand, looking up at the glow on the wall top; his feet stay where they are. Along the wall, small, a dozen more people stand in ones and twos, every one of them outside it; the city gate stands open and nobody goes through. Far down the cart road behind them the lanterns of a wagon train take the long way round the pass. Snow dust and two or three loose tags blow large and blurred across the near corners.
nodes.note: 收束第五拍（源稿第1461行）：第二年开春，几户井人家回到山口，在那一圈墙上系木牌，一块一个名字，墙东离井绳巷最近，系得最密；入夜墙里的白晶一圈一圈亮起来，系牌的人只在墙外站着。往南的车路绕开它照第1460行。画里没有有立绘的人（尼亚尔没有出城）。木牌上的名字写成认不出的细痕。

nodes.line: 繁荣的年月·三十七枚旧字
nodes.name: 根门夜开
nodes.light: a line of silver-white light racing away inside the bark, a dull hot red glow welling up from a crack in the floor, small warm lamps in opening doorways, deep green-black beyond
nodes.camera: low on the root beside the runner's raised hand, looking along the root down the tunnel as the doors open, strongly tilted
nodes.text: Scene: deep night inside a sanctuary hollowed among the roots of a tree as big as a mountain, in the heart of a primeval forest. Walls and floor are living root, each root as thick as a house, and on the right a root tunnel as wide as a street leads away into the dark, lined on both sides with the small round doors of root houses. Across the white stone floor a fresh crack runs from under the sanctuary toward the tunnel, and a dull red, hot glow wells up out of it. In the foreground the green-haired barefoot root-runner, a wood elf who looks nineteen, willow-green hair cut short at the ears, long pointed ears, bare muddy feet, lies stretched on his stomach along a great root in full profile facing right, his cheek pressed to the bark: his right hand is raised flat a hand's width above the root, about to come down for the second of two slaps, and his left hand is spread on the bark beside his face. From under his hands a line of silver-white light is racing away inside the bark, down the root and along the tunnel wall, and where it passes the round doors are swinging open one after another: lamplight in them, families stepping out with sleeping children in their arms and bundles on their backs, all of them walking away from us down the tunnel. Behind the runner, facing us, stands the silver-haired elf priestess, very long silver-white hair flowing over a pale vestment: her right palm is laid flat on an upright root as if listening through it, her left arm points down the tunnel, and her mouth is open, giving an order. At the edge of the crack, small, two forest guards in green hold torches low over the red glow. Motes of silver light and falling leaves drift large and blurred across the near corners.
nodes.note: 一幕第五、六拍（源稿第1762、1763行）：塞莉卡说先把孩子送出去，往外的那条根道现在就开；沃恩伏在根上拍了两下，停一停，又拍两下，根皮底下一道银白的光顺着根往外跑，根屋的门一间一间开了。缝里的暗红光照第1760行。篡根者没画进这一幅。孩子是被抱着往外走的，不受伤。

nodes.line: 繁荣的年月·三十七枚旧字
nodes.name: 血字
nodes.light: silver-white light from a row of small marks on the root lighting her bowed face from below, torch fire above, a dull red glow in the crack, green-black dark behind
nodes.camera: close at the height of her writing hand, looking up past her bowed head at the root-head coming down, strongly tilted
nodes.text: Scene: late morning in a sanctuary hollowed among the roots of a tree as big as a mountain. The white stone floor has tilted, and a crack runs across it with a dull red glow in it. Along one great root a row of small old marks, more than twenty, has been written on the bark, and every one of them shines silver-white. At the end of the row the silver-haired elf priestess kneels in full profile facing right, very long silver-white hair, a pale vestment, her head bowed over her work: with the middle finger of her right hand, its tip cut and bleeding, she is drawing the last stroke of a new mark on the bark, and her left hand is braced flat on the root; three of her other fingertips are bound in strips of cloth. She does not look up. Straight above her, bursting out of the crack and filling the top of the picture, a pale root-head thicker than a man's body is plunging down at her: a blind white root, cold and swollen, with no face and no eyes, whose long tendrils have drawn together into a ring like an opening mouth. Four forest guards in green stand under it shoulder to shoulder and hold it off with their shoulders and with burning torches, short knives hacking at the tendrils; a cut strand lies on the floor breathing cold mist. Three of the root-head's strands are already pinned flat to the bark, each one nailed there under a shining mark. Behind the priestess, sitting bolt upright and facing us, the silver-blue-braided archivist, waist-length silver-blue hair in one loose braid, steadies a small open wooden casket bound with silver twigs on her knees with her left hand, and with two fingers of her right hand lifts a leaf so thin the light shines through it. Beside her an old elf councillor in a long robe holds a lamp up with both hands. Torch sparks and white root fibres fly large and blurred across the near corners.
nodes.note: 二幕对头第二手（源稿第1774行）：念到二十几枚，根头从缝里整个探出来，须子合成一张口朝跪着的塞莉卡扑下去，四个守卫拿肩膀和火把架住它；塞莉卡没有抬头，一口气连写三枚，三枚都割在右手中指上，每亮一枚它头上就有一绺须钉死在根皮上。妮瑟捏着叶柄翻残叶照第1769行，老议员替她举灯照第1773行。指尖写割破流血，不画见骨。篡根者没有脸。

nodes.line: 繁荣的年月·三十七枚旧字
nodes.name: 根上银火
nodes.light: silver-white light pouring out of thirty-seven small marks under her hands and racing away through the roots, turning trees the size of mountains translucent from root to crown; deep green-black forest night beyond
nodes.camera: low on the root floor in front of her hands, looking up past her at the lit trunks soaring overhead, strongly tilted
nodes.text: Scene: night in the heart of a primeval forest whose trees are as big as mountains, in a sanctuary hollowed among the roots of the oldest tree. Along one great root, as thick as a house, a row of thirty-seven small old marks is cut into the bark, and every one of them is blazing silver-white; the last mark in the row has a fresh crack across it. Kneeling at the root in the middle of the picture, facing us, is the silver-haired elf priestess: very long silver-white hair flowing over a pale vestment, no ornament in it, her face drained and steady, her lips parted in recitation. Both her hands are pressed flat on the root, all ten fingertips set on the bark, the fingertips worn raw. From under her hands the silver light runs out along the root in every direction like fire along a fuse, and beyond her the trunks of the giant trees are lighting up one after another, each tree glowing through from its roots to its highest leaves, a river of brightness flowing away under the canopy toward the horizon. In the root floor at her knees a thick pale root that does not belong, swollen and whitish like a parasite, with no face and no eyes, is writhing up out of the bark and crumbling to white ash from its tips inward where the light touches it. Around the sanctuary, small lamps left burning at the doors of empty root houses. Silver sparks and falling leaves drift large and blurred across the near corners.
nodes.note: 三幕第六拍（源稿第1745行那一条）：塞莉卡把十个见骨的指尖全按回根上，从头一枚念起，三十七枚字亮到最亮，银白从圣所顺着根一路烧到外林，一棵一棵山一样的老树从根到梢透亮；篡根者从须尖往里一截一截成了白灰（它在根门那一头，这里把圣所底下它留着的那一截画进来）。指尖只写磨破，不画见骨。

nodes.line: 繁荣的年月·三十七枚旧字
nodes.name: 手背拨叶
nodes.light: soft green-gold early light falling in shafts between giant roots onto still water, cool shade under the roots, a pale glint on a small clay jar
nodes.camera: at the level of the water, close on her bandaged hands and the floating leaves, her face above them, slightly tilted
nodes.text: Scene: early morning at a small spring under the roots of a giant tree, in a sanctuary deep in a primeval forest; the pool is clear and still, ringed with flat grey stones, and fallen leaves float on it. Roots as thick as houses arch overhead, and thin shafts of green-gold light come down between them. At the edge of the pool the silver-haired elf priestess kneels in full profile facing left, very long silver-white hair gathered over one shoulder, in a plain pale everyday robe with the sleeves folded back. All ten of her fingers are bound in clean strips of white cloth, and the bound middle finger of her right hand is one joint shorter than the rest. She cannot pick anything up: with the back of her right hand she is nudging one floating leaf toward the stone rim, where a small neat row of wet leaves already lies drying, and her left hand rests bandaged on her knee. Her face is calm and a little tired, her eyes on the leaf. On the bank beside her knee stands a small plain clay jar with a cloth lid and no mark on it at all. Behind her, far off between the roots, small, a few families with bundles are walking toward a newly cut round opening in a root wall, and one old woman has stopped to lay her palm on the bark, where a thin line of silver light shows under her hand. Motes of morning light and one drifting leaf hang large and soft in the near corners.
nodes.note: 收束第三拍（源稿第1791行）：回到根下圣域的第二天清早，塞莉卡照旧去泉眼，缠着布的手指捞不了叶子，就拿手背一片一片拨到石边；右手中指末一节没有保住；岸上多了一罐没有字的止血膏。远处沃恩的祖母把手按在壁上、根皮底下亮了一道，是第1793行第二年春末的事，当远景借进来了，拿不准可去掉。

nodes.line: 繁荣的年月·外环那一条龙
nodes.name: 鳞上折箭
nodes.light: silent white fire flooding the forest floor from the right, a pale green-white glow through the dragon's bare hide, deep green night on the left where the trees still live
nodes.camera: low on the great root behind the line of archers, looking up at the dragon's head and the fire coming along the root, strongly tilted
nodes.text: Scene: night in a primeval forest of giant trees. A line runs through the forest: on the left the trees are dark and green, on the right every tree has turned white from the root upward and its leaves are crumbling to white ash, and there is no smoke anywhere. Along a root thicker than a man is tall, an ancient dragon has crawled out of a split in the ground and fills the right of the picture: a huge old wyrm with half its scales flaked away and a pale green-white light showing through the bare hide, both wings rotted to hanging shreds, pressed low along the root, its two eyes two unblinking lamps. A stream of white fire pours from its jaws without a sound, and where it passes the forest sinks into drifts of white ash. In the middle distance ten elf archers in forest green stand in a ragged line on the root, bows raised, and their arrows are striking the dragon's scales and snapping, a rain of broken shafts falling. In front of the line, in full profile facing right, stands the white-haired old watcher, a tall spare elf who looks about fifty, white-grey hair cropped very short, his own bow still on his back: his right arm is stretched out pointing past the dragon at the glowing split behind its tail, his left hand hangs open at his side, and the white fire has reached the root at his feet. Beside him on the left, facing us, the green-braided elf ranger, long dark green hair in a ranger's braid, holds a yew longbow in his left hand, a second bow wrapped in sackcloth across his back, and flings his right arm out toward the left, toward the living trees, shouting the order to fall back. White ash and broken arrow shafts fly large and blurred across the near corners.
nodes.note: 一幕第四、五拍（源稿第2027、2028行）：它从缝里爬出来，鳞剥落了一半，两翼烂成一绺一绺，贴着根爬，吐白火，火烧过去不响；十把弓一齐放箭，箭在它鳞上一支一支折断；提洛恩站着看了半夜，指着它背后说节拍不在它身上，白火已经到了他脚下。提洛恩、欧伦、娜伊三个人没有出来那一下不画。枯冠用史诗战外环古龙一阶的图当设计参考。

nodes.line: 繁荣的年月·外环那一条龙
nodes.name: 树洞白火
nodes.light: soundless white fire spilling from a hollow tree on the right and lighting the falling ash, cold blue night under the canopy, a few forgotten market lanterns still warm
nodes.camera: from the deer path just above the market, past the young ranger's pointing arm, looking down at the burning hollow and the falling boardwalk, strongly tilted
nodes.text: Scene: night at the northern edge of a forest market built on timber boardwalks among giant old trees; the stalls are shuttered and empty. From the hollow in the trunk of the northernmost tree, a tree three hundred years old and as wide as a tower, soundless white fire is pouring out like water from a spout. The tree is turning white from the inside outward, bark and all, its leaves raining down as white ash, and no smoke rises. Under it a length of boardwalk has just given way and is dropping into the dark, planks and lanterns falling with it. Through the ground a glowing split runs in from the right along a root thicker than a man is tall, straight to the foot of that tree. In the foreground, on a narrow deer path that climbs away to the left, the honey-haired young ranger, a wood elf girl who looks seventeen, short honey-coloured hair cut at the ears, long pointed ears, a short bow across her back, stands in full profile facing left at the head of a file of the last market people: her left arm is stretched out pointing the way up the path, her right hand grips a roll of birch bark with a route scratched on it, and her face is tight and set. Behind her, small, twenty or so traders and porters hurry after her up the path with packs, a hand-cart and one wicker cage of herons, all of them unhurt, none looking back. On a stone table at the foot of a timber bell tower, a single leaf lies pinned under a pebble. Far off through the trunks a pale band of white glow shows where the canopy has died. White ash and sparks of lantern oil drift large and blurred across the near corners.
nodes.note: 二幕对头第二手（源稿第2036行）：八日夜里它把白火灌进缝里，火顺着那条根在地底下走，从林市最北一棵老树的树洞里冒出来，三百年的树从里往外白，木栈塌了一截；琪雅拉领着最后一批守货的人走鹿道绕开那条根。石台上那片叶子照第2035行，桦皮照第2033行。琪雅拉在木精灵里还算孩子，画成没有受伤、领路的一下。黛薇诺那一矛没有立绘，没画。

nodes.line: 繁荣的年月·外环那一条龙
nodes.name: 根木之弓
nodes.light: a thin line of blue-green light leaving the bow and running away north, cold white dragon fire in the background, pale boundary stones humming with a faint glow, deep forest night
nodes.camera: close beside the archer's bow hand, looking along the arrow's path toward the dragon, strongly tilted
nodes.text: Scene: the last hour of a summer night at the edge of a great forest, on a line of tall white boundary stones; a bell tower of timber stands on the right, its foot scorched white, and all its bells are swinging. Beyond the stones, filling the background, an ancient dragon has come to the very edge: a huge old wyrm stripped of most of its scales, pale light showing through the bare hollows in its hide, breathing two streams of silent white fire; under the root of its tail a seam in its body has just opened and shines. In the foreground the green-braided elf ranger stands on a white stone in full profile facing right, at full draw: long dark green hair in a ranger's braid with two leather cords woven in, his left hand gripping the middle of a long bow of white wood with a green sheen, his right hand at his cheek having just loosed. The bow has been drawn past what a bow can bear and is cracking apart at the grip in that same instant, splinters flying, and the arrow is already gone: a single straight blue-green line runs from the bow through the dragon's body to the open seam and on toward a far lake. Every treetop for miles is bowed toward the white stones. At the foot of the stone, lying on a root in full profile facing right with his ear pressed to the bark, the flaxen-haired dragonborn listener, fine green scales at his hairline, has his right hand flung up in the signal to shoot, his left hand flat on the root. On the bell tower, small, a honey-haired girl leans over the rail pointing north. Splinters, leaves and white embers fly large and blurred across the near corners.
nodes.note: 三幕第五、六拍（源稿第2010行那一条）：奥韦的手抬了起来，这一下；埃兰迪尔把弓拉开，外环十二座巡林铃一齐响了，几十里的林冠朝白石这边伏下来，弓拉过了一张弓该到的地方，断了，箭照旧出去了；一道青线从白石一直亮到湖北岸，钉进它尾巴底下刚张开的口子。弦割开肩骨那一下不画，画弓刚裂、箭已经出去的一瞬。枯冠用史诗战外环古龙二阶的图当设计参考。琪雅拉在铃塔上是远处的小人。

nodes.line: 繁荣的年月·外环那一条龙
nodes.name: 绿枝未蔫
nodes.light: a clear cold autumn morning, low gold sun from the left, frost shining on grass and on tall white stones, long blue shadows across the road
nodes.camera: low at the roadside beside the crouching dragonborn, looking up at the girl on the white stone and the wagon passing under the lifted pole, slightly tilted
nodes.text: Scene: a clear frosty autumn morning on a trade road at the edge of a great forest, by a line of tall white boundary stones. A new timber guard post stands beside the road with a long pole across it, and the pole is swinging up. Under it the first wagon of the season, a heavy covered trade wagon drawn by two oxen, is rolling through; lashed upright to the front of the wagon is a cut green branch, and every leaf on it is still fresh and green. On top of the nearest white stone, facing us, stands the honey-haired young ranger, a wood elf girl who looks seventeen, short honey-coloured hair, long pointed ears, a forest-green cloak: her bow hangs unstrung in her left hand, her right hand is empty and open at her side, and she is giving one short nod down toward the roadside. There, crouched on his heels beside the post in full profile facing right, is the flaxen-haired dragonborn listener, very short flaxen hair, a band of fine green scales along his hairline and down the back of his neck, a tame grey heron standing at his knee: his left hand rests on the frosty grass, his right hand holds a second green branch up toward the wagon to compare the leaves, and one corner of his mouth has lifted. A guard in forest green hauls on the rope of the pole. Behind the stones, along a great root where the bark has closed over an old split, grows a ring of new shoots, white with a green sheen, and a pair of antlers has been leaned against the root beside them. Frost motes and a few yellow leaves drift large and soft in the near corners.
nodes.note: 收束第五拍（源稿第2056行）：秋天外环商路靠林界起了一座哨，过哨的车头插一截带叶的绿枝；霜降月头一辆过哨的车，车头的绿枝一路没蔫，守哨的人抬了杆，站在白石上的琪雅拉没有拉弓，朝哨边蹲着的奥韦点了一下头。根上那一圈白里透绿的新芽和鹿角照第2052、2053行。

notes: 11-25：这一页先写了头四条主线（十六幅）。一座城自己的井、三十七枚旧字、外环那一条龙三条先各写了头一轮那一幅，别的幕后补。
